mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.5% indicates active monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through lower cost of capital for equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over one month indicate broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward 20-day returns due to heightened recession risk from aggressive rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, strengthening corporate earnings outlook and driving positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals housing sector weakness, reducing consumer wealth and driving negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls > 5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% monthly decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue visibility and driving negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS falls > 2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals over-tightening policy amid disinflation, driving negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls.
